newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Coceral sees 16.4 mln t EU 96/97 soft wheat export.
newsitem.headline: Coceral sees 16.4 mln t EU 96/97 soft wheat export.

text.p: European Union exports of soft wheat and flour will total 16.4 million tonnes in 1996/97 (July/June), up from 12.1 million tonnes in 1995/96, Coceral, the EU grain trade lobby forecast.
Exports of barley and malt were seen rising to 7.7 million tonnes, from 4.5 million over the same period.
Coceral estimated European Union grain production at 204.3 million tonnes in 1996/97 (July/June), up from 203.0 million tonnes estimated in December and a 175.8 million tonne crop in 1995/96.
The estimate, based on figures presented by EU member states, was discussed at a meeting of the EU's cereals advisory committee made up of EU Commission, trade and producer representatives.
Sources said the main disagreement was over the amount of grain used in animal feed with the EU figure some five million tonnes lower than trade estimates.
